scope: Learning attribution and diagnostic checks, not confirmatory thesis evidence
selection: First six validation records of each true class in saved source order, sorted by validation position; first misclassified validation record added as an illustrative case only if absent. Only the balanced twelve contribute to headline means.
target: Original predicted-class logit margin: sign*(logit_M-logit_B), sign=+1 for original M prediction and -1 for original B. Keep target sign fixed for perturbation, alternate models, and randomization.
baseline: Coordinatewise median of training-scaled features; no held-out baseline fitting

gradcam.interpretation: 5x6 localization map indexed through feature coordinates; spatial proxy, not exact per-input attribution

lime.comparison_values: standardized local coefficient times (x-training_median)/training_std; retain raw coefficients and fit diagnostics, not exact additive attributions

perturbation.ranking: descending signed support, ties by original feature index; fixed k; report zero-map methods as ineligible
perturbation.replacement: training median in original feature coordinates, then encode; equivalent replacement in scaled coordinates
perturbation.score: drop in original predicted-class logit margin, not probability
perturbation.limits: Independent replacement can violate correlated feature structure; not causal evidence

agreement: Spearman on absolute magnitudes and top-5 Jaccard; constant maps yield null, not invented correlation

randomization.target: keep original target sign, never switch to randomized model class

tabular_comparison: Explain the frozen logistic-regression log-odds with Kernel SHAP and LIME using the same baseline/neighborhood settings; compare to its exact linear baseline-relative effects. Cross-model agreement is descriptive, never CNN ground truth.
test_policy: No test-set explanations, new classifier training, threshold changes, or post-result setting search. Numerical IG quadrature refinement follows the predefined residual rule only.
